summary.label: New
summary.text: Timephoria pushed a new skintint stick through mid-tier reviewers; the top two reviews drew 5.2M and 4.7M views.

summary.label: Working
summary.text: Glad2Glow's cushion tutorials by one mid-tier creator lifted engagement from 0.9%; the top post drew 4.0M views.

summary.label: Worth testing
summary.text: Skintific ran one cushion hashtag across 15 creators, and every post on the tag was theirs.

scoreboard_title: Timephoria's skintint push leads; Glad2Glow and Skintific also moved
movers_title: Three brands moved outside their normal range

drivers.title: Timephoria's skintint stick: big reach, thin engagement
drivers.why: Mid-tier reviewers carried a new skintint stick: 125 creators posted, double last week's 62, and Instagram views rose from 81K to 34.5M. Engagement stayed at 0.2%, so the reach looks paid rather than earned.
drivers.attention_to_action: Reviews built awareness, but Instagram has no cart and engagement is thin. Watch whether the stick reaches TikTok Shop next.

drivers.title: Glad2Glow's cushion tutorials lifted engagement
drivers.why: One mid-tier creator, @chika_adelia16, posted two cushion tutorials worth 5.9M views; the bigger one alone was 35% of the brand's week. Nano creators rose to 58% of creator posts while brand accounts fell to 19% of views.
drivers.attention_to_action: Tutorials drove engagement, but cart share fell from 66% to 49%: the cushion won attention without a matching push to buy.

drivers.title: Skintific seeded a cushion hashtag through new creators
drivers.why: Skintific's posts fell 25% while the TikTok panel fell 49%, lifting its share of posts to 5.5%. 82% of its creators were first-time in 8 weeks, and 15 used #skintificcushion, a tag no other brand used.
drivers.attention_to_action: Volume without reach: 1.2M views in the week and cart share down from 42% to 26%. The tag makes the seeding easy to track, not yet to sell.

actions.title: Meet the skintint stick where people buy
actions.detail: Timephoria's stick lives in Instagram reviews with no cart. A base-product review series on TikTok with cart links meets the same shopper closer to checkout.

actions.title: Brief tutorials, not showcases, for cushion pushes
actions.detail: Glad2Glow's engagement came from application tutorials, while product showcases were 35% of its posts. Test tutorial briefs on the next cushion wave.

actions.title: Give every seeding wave its own hashtag
actions.detail: Skintific's #skintificcushion made 15 creators readable as one number. One tag per wave shows each wave's reach and cart share, week by week.

portfolio_note: Kahf's Instagram views rose from 909K to 19.1M, lifting Paragon's Instagram engagement rate from 2.0% to 8.4%.
